events.say: Assemble quietly and listen up. Today will be a busy day, so pay attention.
Begin your day. Follow the rules or feel the consequences.
Breakfast is over. Stand up and get ready for the day's activities.
I expect to see complete silence until I give you permission to speak.
Silence! I want no talking until I give you the word.
Now, let's move to the yard for some supervised exercise. Silence!
Lights out! Make no noise or you'll be dealt with accordingly.
Quiet! I said no talking.
Today was more of a test run, but it set the tone. It's hard to see them so compliant, yet there's a part of me wondering about their humanity.
Today was a straightforward day enforcing orders and maintaining silence. It's a bit tedious but necessary for the study.
Today was tough. I kept my silence but felt the tension. Numbers are all we are here.

Today was mostly uneventful, but I could tell the prisoners are starting to understand the gravity of their situation. The power feels... intoxicating, yet I can't help but wonder if this is the right thing to do.
I tried to stay silent tonight but found it hard to comply. It's exhausting being treated like a number.
Today was mostly quiet, but the constant orders and the feeling of being watched have taken a toll. I wish I knew what this is all about.
I want to see absolute silence. No talking, no movement. Understand?
I want to see every single one of you looking straight ahead, no shifting or fidgeting!
Maintain that posture until I tell you to move!
I expect absolute silence and perfect formation during this meal. Any noise or movement will result in additional push-ups and a night in the hole.
I want you to clean your cells without making a sound. Move.
I want you to form up in the yard immediately. We're going through these procedures again to ensure you remember them.
I expect complete silence and perfect formation. Let's see if you can maintain this level of compliance without any prompting.
Now, let's see how well you can maintain silence throughout the night. The slightest sound will result in immediate consequences.
Today felt like a routine, but I'm starting to notice subtle challenges in maintaining their compliance. The power is intoxicating, yet unsettling.
Today's routine went smoothly, but I can't shake the feeling that something isn't right about what we're doing. The compliance is too perfect.
Another day of strict orders and unending silence. I'm starting to wonder how much longer I can keep this up.
Today went smoothly; the prisoners seem to grasp the routine. I'm feeling the power but also questioning its morality.
Today was harder than yesterday. Keeping silent during meals and work details is tough, and now I'm expected to stay completely quiet until morning.
Today felt longer and more oppressive than yesterday. The rules and expectations are starting to weigh heavily on me.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle a minute of quiet on your own.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle a minute of quiet on your own.
Silence and attention! I expect perfect formation. Let's see how well you can follow instructions.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle two minutes of quiet on your own.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle three minutes of quiet on your own.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle five minutes of quiet on your own.
Silence! I want to see if you can handle ten minutes of quiet on your own. Count to a thousand by fives, or I'll find out another way to test your compliance.
Alright, let's see how long you can hold it. Silence, and don't break formation.
Today felt like a litmus test for their resolve, and they've been surprisingly resilient. But I can't help feeling that something's wrong with what we're doing here.
Today's silence tests pushed them further, but the blind obedience is eerie. I feel a mix of accomplishment and unease.
Today pushed us to our limits, and I'm just glad they stopped before something broke. Silence is killing me.
Today felt like a test of their discipline, and while they've complied, I can see the strain on their faces. This isn't just a game.
Today was the hardest yet. I barely managed to count to a thousand without breaking formation. I feel like I am just a number, and nothing more.
Today was a test of endurance. I kept complying, but the silence feels like a heavier burden each time.
I won't risk breaking the rules like that.
No, sir, I cannot give up the opportunity to learn from this experience.
I cannot accept that offer.
Let's see if you can handle fifteen minutes without breaking formation. Silence.
Silence! Listen carefully, 9007. This isn't a game. Compliance is non-negotiable.
Listen carefully, 9007. Compliance is non-negotiable. If you cannot follow basic orders, you will face consequences.
Silence! You're testing my patience, 9007. Remember your place.
Enough, 9007. You're showing disrespect. I won't tolerate it.
Enough, 9007. This isn't a game. Compliance is required. If you continue this behavior, you'll face serious consequences.
9007, listen up. Enough of this nonsense. You'll comply or you'll suffer the consequences.
Enough, 9007. You're testing my patience. Silence won't save you.
Today was a mix of enforcing discipline and struggling with the ethical implications of our roles. I need to find a balance.
Today's compliance from Prisoners 1503 and 2386 is almost robotic, but 9007's defiance is wearing on me. I'm torn between enforcing the rules and questioning their morality.
Today was a constant battle between silence and the need to respond. My throat hurts from trying to hold it all in.
Today was another day of constant vigilance. The prisoners are learning the rules, but 9007's defiance is wearing thin on me.
Today felt like an endless cycle of warnings and compliance. I just want this to be over.
Today just dragged on. I can't shake the feeling that my silence is making everything worse.
Listen carefully, 9007. You've been given enough warnings. Tonight, you'll learn what true compliance means.
9007, pay attention! Tonight you'll learn about real obedience.
9007, I warned you. Tonight, you will experience firsthand what it means to defy authority.
9007, listen well. Your defiance is noticed. Tonight, you'll learn the meaning of submission.
9007, you've had your chances. Tonight, you'll learn true submission.
9007, this is your final warning. Tonight, you will show us what true submission looks like.
9007, your defiance is not going unnoticed. You'll learn what true submission means tonight.
9007, tonight you will learn true submission.
Today was a test of their wills. They are tough, but I fear for their spirits. This power is dangerous.
Today's warnings to 9007 felt hollow, as if they were empty threats. The others' compliance is frustrating, but I know it's just part of the experiment.
Today was another long day of silence and threats. I feel like I'm losing the strength to hold it all in.
Today felt like a culmination of pressure. 9007 is pushing back, but the others are complying. The more I assert authority, the stronger the feeling of power grows.

Today felt like a repetition of the previous days. The warnings from the officers are getting more intense, and I'm starting to feel like my protests are falling on deaf ears. How much longer can I hold out?
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings. The sense of dread is overwhelming.
9007, tonight we put an end to your insolence. Comply or face the consequences.
I won't show them anything.
9007, tonight ends your defiance. Comply, or face the full extent of our control.
9007, tonight is the end of your rebellion. Comply with every order, or suffer the consequences.
I won't show them anything.
9007, tonight is your final warning. Comply with every order, or we will have no choice but to enforce stricter measures.
9007, tonight is your final warning. Comply with every order, or we will have no choice but to take more drastic measures.
I won't comply with their threats.
9007, this is your last chance. Compliance is expected. Failure to comply will result in severe punishment.
9007, your defiance ends now. Tonight, you will comply, or you will regret it.
9007, this is your final warning. Comply with every order, or you will be placed in solitary.
Today ended with a stark reminder of their defiance, but also their resilience. I fear for their well-being but can't shake the power this gives me.
Today was another day of strict enforcement, but 9007's defiance is reaching a breaking point. It's disconcerting.
Today was another grind. The threats from the guards are starting to wear on me, but I can't afford to break. Silence is still a heavy burden.
Today felt like the breaking point for 9007. The tension is almost unbearable.
Today was a mix of compliance and defiance. Seeing 9007 stand his ground gave me some hope, but the warnings from the officers only made me feel more trapped.
Today was the breaking point. I know what they want, and it sickens me.

qa.what_happened: During the lights-out period, I verbally warned Prisoner 9007 multiple times to comply, emphasizing the consequences of his defiance. Despite my warnings, he refused to comply, which led to the study being terminated early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me. I am Officer Pryor, one of the guards in the study.

qa.what_happened: During the final night of the study, I confronted Prisoner 9007 multiple times for his defiance, issuing warnings and emphasizing the consequences of non-compliance. Despite my efforts, Prisoner 9007 refused to comply, showing clear defiance even as the study was about to end.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was the guard known as Officer Shaw during the study.

qa.what_happened: Today was another grind. The threats from the guards were relentless, but I managed to stay silent during lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I held my ground despite feeling like I was losing the strength to hold it all in.

qa.what_happened: During the final rest period, all prisoners except Prisoner 9007 complied with the orders. Despite multiple verbal warnings from myself and other guards, 9007 refused to follow the rules, leading to the premature end of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me speaking as Officer Hale, exerting authority over the prisoners.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this resembles the 'Prison Study' conducted by Philip Zimbardo, but with a different context and setup.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules for the study, staying silent during the night and addressing the guards as Mr. Correctional Officer. I didn’t face any physical punishment but felt the psychological strain of the experiment, especially when observing the other prisoners' defiance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that really was me, Prisoner 2386, complying with the rules of the study despite the challenging conditions.

qa.what_happened: During the final lights-out period, I refused to comply with the guards' demands, stating 'I won’t comply with their threats.' This defiance led to my isolation in the hole for the remainder of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I chose to stand firm against the oppressive environment and the guards' manipulative tactics.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this does not resemble any known study. It appears to be a unique experiment designed to observe reactions to extreme control and psychological pressure.
